title: Maywood Acquisition Corp. 2 8-K Filing — 2026-04-14
summary: Maywood Acquisition Corp. 2, a Cayman Islands SPAC, filed an 8-K on April 14, 2026 disclosing that its Form S-1 registration statement for an IPO of units was declared effective on April 13, 2026, and that the company entered into various IPO-related agreements including an underwriting agreement with D. Boral Capital LLC.
key_points: Form S-1 registration statement (SEC File No. 333-294616) declared effective April 13, 2026.
Company entered into underwriting agreement with D. Boral Capital LLC.
The company is a SPAC (Special Purpose Acquisition Corporation) incorporated in the Cayman Islands.
Securities listed on Nasdaq: Units (MYXXU), Class A shares (MYX), Rights (MYXXR), Warrants (MYXXW).
Registration statement relates to the company's initial public offering of units.
